## Blocks

Block

[![Block](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/3/34/Block.jpg/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/100?cb=20190317004603)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/3/34/Block.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20190317004603)

The basic block (a cube) you will use to build vehicles, side length 0.25 metres (1 unit). Has a mass of 1.

Wedge

[![Wedge](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/d/d7/Wedge.jpg/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/100?cb=20190317004805)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/d/d7/Wedge.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20190317004805)

A basic building block for creating faces at a 45 degree angle to the axes. Has a mass of 0.5, takes up 1x1x1 units of space.

Wedge 1x2

[![Wedge 1x2](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/5/5c/Wedge_1x2.png/revision/latest?cb=20200129211706)

A basic building block for creating faces at a ~27 degree angle to the axes. Has a mass of 1, takes up 1x2x1 units of space.

Wedge 1x4

[![Wedge 1x4](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/8/80/Wedge_1x4.png/revision/latest?cb=20200129211715)

A basic building block for creating faces at a ~14 degree angle to the axes. Has a mass of 2, takes up 1x4x1 units of space.

Inverse Pyramid

[![Inverse Pyramid](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/c/cf/Inverse_Pyramid.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20190317004630)

A basic building block for creating faces at a 45 degree angle in two directions. Has a mass of 0.75, takes up 1x1x1 units of space.

Inverse Pyramid 1x2

[![Inverse Pyramid 1x2](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/6/69/Inverse_Pyramid_1x2.png/revision/latest?cb=20200129211803)

A basic building block for creating faces in two directions. Has a mass of 2, takes up 1x2x1 units of space.

Inverse Pyramid 1x4

[![Inverse Pyramid 1x4](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/2/26/Inverse_Pyramid_1x4.png/revision/latest?cb=20200129211738)

A basic building block for creating faces in two directions. Has a mass of 3, takes up 1x4x1 units of space.

Inverse Pyramid 2x2

[![Inverse Pyramid 2x2](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/c/c7/Inverse_Pyramid_2x2.png/revision/latest?cb=20200129211815)

A basic building block for creating faces in two directions. Has a mass of 3, takes up 2x2x1 units of space.

Inverse Pyramid 2x4

[![Inverse Pyramid 2x4](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/d/da/Inverse_Pyramid_2x4.png/revision/latest?cb=20200129211822)

A basic building block for creating faces in two directions. Has a mass of 6, takes up 2x4x1 units of space.

Inverse Pyramid 4x4

[![Inverse Pyramid 4x4](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/e/e5/Inverse_Pyramid_4x4.png/revision/latest?cb=20200129211838)

A basic building block for creating faces in two directions. Has a mass of 12, takes up 4x4x1 units of space.

Pyramid

[![Pyramid](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/d/d0/Pyramid.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20190317004731)

A basic building block for creating faces at a 45 degree angle in two directions. Has a mass of 0.25, takes up 1x1x1 units of space.

Pyramid 1x2

[![Pyramid 1x2](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/6/6a/Pyramid_1x2.png/revision/latest?cb=20200129211847)

A basic building block for creating faces in two directions. Has a mass of 0.5, takes up 1x2x1 units of space.

Pyramid 1x4

[![Pyramid 1x4](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/0/0e/Pyramid_1x4.png/revision/latest?cb=20200129211854)

A basic building block for creating faces in two directions. Has a mass of 1, takes up 1x4x1 units of space.

Pyramid 2x2

[![Pyramid 2x2](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/e/ea/Pyramid_2x2.png/revision/latest?cb=20200129211900)

A basic building block for creating faces in two directions. Has a mass of 1, takes up 2x2x1 units of space.

Pyramid 2x4

[![Pyramid 2x4](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/9/99/Pyramid_2x4.png/revision/latest?cb=20200129211908)

A basic building block for creating faces in two directions. Has a mass of 2, takes up 2x4x1 units of space.

Pyramid 4x4

[![Pyramid 4x4](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/e/ef/Pyramid_4x4.png/revision/latest?cb=20200129211915)

A basic building block for creating faces in two directions. Has a mass of 4, takes up 4x4x1 units of space.

Weight Block

[![Weight Block](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/d/d8/Weight_Block.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20190317004816)

A version of the regular building block with ten times the mass. Takes up 1x1x1 units of space.

Stair Step

[![Stair Step](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/d/d5/Stair_Step.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20190317004739)

Stair Top

[![Stair Top](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/d/d6/Stair_Top.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20190317004827)

Handle

[![Handle](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/b/b4/Handle.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20190317004618)

A player can grab this and pull the vehicle.

Ladder

[![Ladder](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/e/e0/Ladder.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20190317004642)

Combine at least 2 of them to use as a ladder. There can be a space of 1 block inbetween them and they will still work as 1 ladder.

Inverse Pyramid

A basic building block for creating faces at a 45 degree angle in two directions. Has a mass of 0.75, takes up 1x1x1 units of space.

Pyramid 1x2
